svg.aria-label: The disclosure mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: a venue or a policy anchor given? (question); You name one (stop); venue in the policy database? (question); Anchor table lookup (agent); Halt: you paste the venue's policy (stop); Each kind of AI use marked used, not used or uncertain (agent); You confirm it (stop); Session metadata: the model of this run (agent); Disclosure paragraph: Claude, the model's name, (Anthropic), in the venue's voice and phrasing (agent); Paragraph and placement (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake: config.md, the venue or the policy anchor [AV12], the kinds of AI use the records of earlier runs leave uncertain, each other kind pre-marked; you confirm [D24, AD10]; a file in words [AQ] (stop); the venue listed? (question); Session: the identifier the runner's model list gives for opus, such as claude-opus-5-5, or the model the first agent was served when the list gives none [N, 5.C (6)] (ruled); Draft writer: the statements as a patch, disclosure.md; the disclosure names that model [D43, D47] (ruled); Draft writer once more: the model identifier, when the list gave none [N] (ruled); Statements and placement (agent); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply, a script failed [C] (stop); At every agent start: a model other than the configured one [D47] (stop).
